_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: NAVAIR Portable Source Initiative (NPSI) Dataset
summary: The NPSI dataset combines refined source data, metadata descriptions, and data license information to maximize database reuse across Type/Model/Series platforms and lower life cycle costs.
use_relationship:
The NPSI dataset contains the combination of refined source data, metadata descriptions, and data license information.

The purpose of the NPSI is to provide maximum database reuse across Type/Model/Series platforms to lower the life cycle cost of out-the-window visual terrain, 3-D models, and sensor databases, along with dataset archive capability, and short-notice distribution services.

This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for a NPSI data deliverable invoked by a solicitation.

children.title: NPSI Final Dataset shall be in the formats and structure defined in reference (a) section 4.1.
NPSI Interim Dataset shall be in formats and structure defined in reference (a) section 4.3.
NPSI Metadata shall be in XML format that validates against the NPSI schema defined in reference (b).
Material Property Reference Database additions shall be in XML format that validates against the schema defined in reference (c).
The NPSI dataset's license files required in 3.4 shall be in contractor format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The NPSI will contain the following information

children.title: NPSI Final Dataset per reference (a) section 5.1.
XML description of material properties used by the system as described in reference (a) section 2.1.8 and reference (c).
NPSI Interim Dataset per reference (a) section 5.2.
NPSI Metadata descriptions per reference (a) section 5.3.
Metadata shall include references to all files, including legacy Government-Furnished Information (GFI) data not included in the NPSI datasets, used to build the database.
The license files of the dataset shall include the following:
The license agreement from the original license holder.
The license agreement for any derivative work by the developer.
children.content: A derivative work is a work based on preexisting works, such as any addition, improvement, update, modification, transformation, adaptation of a work.
